Population increased in West Northamptonshire

The estimated population of West Northamptonshire in 2024 was 439,811 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that West Northamptonshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of West Northamptonshire increased by 3.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, West Northamptonshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of West Northamptonshire

The average (median) age rose to 40 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of West Northamptonshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
West Northamptonshire is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, West Northamptonshire's population of 439,811 usual residents was made up of:

  • 85,289 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.4%)
  • 277,546 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.1%)
  • 76,976 people aged 65 years and over, (17.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, West Northamptonshire has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (17.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In West Northamptonshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in West Northamptonshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for West Northamptonshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 738 people (0.2%). In total, there were 4,435 births and 3,697 deaths in West Northamptonshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 1,728 (-0.4%). There were 20,940 people entering the area and 22,668 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in West Northamptonshire's population of 4,038 (0.9%) as a result of 7,908 people entering the area and 3,870 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for West Northamptonshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of West Northamptonshire in mid-2023 is 436,787.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,075 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 363 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,438 people.
